items.claim: Prioritize a daily exception queue before automating every edge case.
items.excerpt: A focused exception queue reduces manual follow-up while preserving human oversight for unusual transactions.
items.proposal_link: Supports the proposal opening: a controlled reconciliation workflow, not a risky big-bang replacement.

items.claim: Keep source-to-ledger traceability visible for every flagged variance.
items.excerpt: Each exception should retain a source reference, resolution owner and final disposition for review.
items.proposal_link: Supports the proposed audit trail and weekly reconciliation summary.

items.claim: Start with representative exports and agreed acceptance rules.
items.excerpt: A compact discovery sprint aligns fields, tolerances and hand-off expectations before implementation expands.
items.proposal_link: Supports the two-week discovery and prototype phase.

items.claim: Report only the exceptions that require a decision, with their financial context.
items.excerpt: A concise operating view helps managers act without searching through raw exports.
items.proposal_link: Supports the executive-ready weekly variance report.
